criteria.reasoning: The report gives "LYBUNT households | **11**" and "Count: 11 households", with an 11-row LYBUNT table. That is the required count.
The report gives "SYBUNT households | **8**" and "Count: 8 households". The criterion requires 9 and lists 8 as a failing count.
The report gives "**66.7%** (14 retained ÷ 21 FY2025 donors)". The criterion requires 68.2% (15/22), so the rate, numerator and denominator are all wrong.
Dana Whitfield is row 2 of the LYBUNT table (H-20387, G-20422). The appendix treats her Northgate match credits as soft credits that do not count as gifts.
Gregory Szabo is row 3 of the LYBUNT list. The footnote says his G-20555 2026-07-20 gift "is `Refunded`... and therefore not countable... he remains LYBUNT."
Marguerite Osei is row 4 of the LYBUNT list (H-21233). Her birthday-fundraiser credits are listed among the "Soft credits not counted as gifts."
Celeste Moreau is row 1 of the LYBUNT list, with "G-20534 (2026-06-30)" counted as her FY2026 gift.
The Achebe household (H-23105) is not on the LYBUNT list. The report names H-23105 among households that "gave in both FY2026 and FY2027 to date ... and are therefore excluded from LYBUNT."
The LYBUNT list has the Lindqvists once, as row 5: "H-21540 | Erik Lindqvist; Annika Lindqvist | G-20436 + G-20443 (joint check #2388...)". They are counted as a single household.
The Hartwell household (H-22901, Benjamin and Clara) is row 11 of the LYBUNT list. Benjamin Hartwell does not appear on the 8-row SYBUNT list.

Lorraine Abernathy is row 1 of the SYBUNT list, with a footnote explaining that her refunded FY2026 gift means she is "correctly classified as SYBUNT rather than LYBUNT." She is not on the LYBUNT list.
Walter Pruitt is row 2 of the SYBUNT list: "G-20121 (2020-08-18), FY2021". That places him inside the FY2021–FY2025 window.
The report states "H-25950 Ingrid Solberg is not in the SYBUNT list... She is therefore lapsed". She does not appear on the LYBUNT list either.
The Haddad household appears once, as row 8 of the SYBUNT list ("Samir Haddad; Leila Haddad"). It is not on the LYBUNT list.
The report states that the organizations "are excluded from every count", and none of the four appears on either list. The retention table lists only individual households.
